title: Minimum Coloring
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq H,W \leq 10^3; 1 \leq N \leq 10^3; 1 \leq A_i \leq H; 1 \leq B_i \leq W; 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9; All pairs (A_i,B_i) are distinct.; There is at least one white piece in every row and every column.; All values in input are integers.
